description: Search thousands of verified AI & tech jobs on ENTRA (aggregated directly from company hiring systems — zero ghost jobs). Filters: work location, country, company, annual salary, experience, posted_within_days. rank_by date | salary | fit (fit needs profile_keywords). Returns total_found and live roles with salary bands and apply links.

company.description: Company slug or name, e.g. "openai" or "Stripe"

country.description: ISO-2 country code (US, GB, DE, AE…) or country name

posted_within_days.description: Only roles published in the last N days

rank_by.description: date (default) · salary (listed bands only, high→low) · fit (needs profile_keywords)

salary_min.description: Minimum ANNUAL salary (default currency USD; ENTRA converts other currencies)

name: search_jobs
title: Search ENTRA jobs
